description: Source code for the 'upload-config' phase in kubeadm upgrade apply process, handling uploading kubeadm and kubelet configurations to ConfigMaps.

methods.name: NewUploadConfigPhase
methods.description: Creates and returns a new workflow.Phase for uploading configurations.

methods.name: getUploadConfigPhaseFlags
methods.description: Returns the flags used in the upload config phases.

methods.name: runUploadKubeadmConfig
methods.description: Uploads kubeadm ClusterConfiguration to a ConfigMap, supports dry run.

methods.name: runUploadKubeletConfig
methods.description: Uploads kubelet configuration to a ConfigMap and removes CRISocket annotation, supports dry run.

methods.name: getUploadConfigData
methods.description: Retrieves upload configuration data from workflow.RunData.
